2052. Binary Search - First Element Greater Than or Equal to Target

50

Medium

Problem Statement
Given a sorted array and a target value, find the first element whose value is greater than or equal to the target using binary search.
Description
Read a sorted array in ascending order and a target value. Use binary search to find the first index `i` such that `a[i] >= target`. If every element is smaller than the target, print -1.
input_spec: The first line contains an integer n. The second line contains n space-separated integers in ascending order. The third line contains an integer target.
output_spec: Print the 0-based index of the first element greater than or equal to target. If no such element exists, print -1.
